gaps.reason: No current application relation/capability proves artifact digest, retention and signed read reference.
gaps.required_action: Publish a typed artifact metadata/signed-reference capability; do not expose storage paths or arbitrary artifact reads.

gaps.reason: No current relation proves deployment-to-research-run linkage.
gaps.required_action: Publish immutable research-run linkage only if the producer owns a stable identifier.

gaps.reason: Portfolio snapshot grain can span profile/venue; direct profile-scoped serving is not evidenced.
gaps.required_action: Keep profile-scoped portfolio equity as an explicit account-input derivation or publish a scope-qualified producer.

gaps.reason: Position mark value/time has no proven source lineage field.
gaps.required_action: Publish mark/index/last provenance and source timestamp in a typed valuation contract.

gaps.reason: Mutable current position rows do not prove a retained lifecycle/version history.
gaps.required_action: Publish an authoritative change journal or retain a versioned position history.

gaps.reason: Current order projection lacks distinct source and broker acknowledgement clocks.
gaps.required_action: Publish durable acknowledgement timestamps with clock authority.

gaps.reason: No global sequence/retention/correction event contract is proven for fill replay.
gaps.required_action: Publish an authoritative change journal before offering incremental replay.

gaps.reason: Session control rows do not by themselves prove full funnel counts or producer version.
gaps.required_action: Publish named session funnel/version fields or a source-owned aggregate capability.

gaps.reason: Sizing/risk records do not prove the complete signal-intent funnel.
gaps.required_action: Publish a durable signal-intent source or a named bounded funnel capability.

gaps.reason: Risk replay/correction needs global ordered event semantics not present in the current audit table.
gaps.required_action: Publish an authoritative ordered change journal before event-level risk replay.

gaps.reason: Snapshot mark values lack a direct source/clock provenance field.
gaps.required_action: Publish mark source, source timestamp and valuation formula revision with snapshots.

gaps.reason: ACKED status lacks immutable acknowledgement time/actor evidence.
gaps.required_action: Publish safe acknowledgement evidence or classify lifecycle as current-status-only.

gaps.reason: Command payloads/receipts can contain sensitive structured data and are not a typed manager-read contract.
gaps.required_action: Publish a field-allowlisted terminal evidence DTO with payload digests and safe references.

gaps.reason: No current Trading-System relation proves latest tick/mark/index/last observations.
gaps.required_action: Adapt the existing market source through a typed latest-observation capability.

gaps.reason: No current Trading-System relation proves bounded OHLCV history/candle completeness.
gaps.required_action: Adapt the existing Data Layer/market source through a typed bounded candle capability.

gaps.reason: No current Trading-System relation proves benchmark series identity, clock and retention.
gaps.required_action: Publish a typed benchmark series or exact derivation inputs.

gaps.reason: Settlement dates are not an intraday trading/auction calendar.
gaps.required_action: Publish typed venue session/holiday windows with venue timezone.

gaps.reason: Raw metadata/trading session JSON is not a safe typed VNM order/session constraint contract.
gaps.required_action: Publish typed VNM order type and session constraint capability.
